exact_text: Bearish divergences help identify uptrend tops.
added_conditions: bearish divergence: prices rally to a new high while an indicator rises to a lower peak
bullish divergence: prices fall to a new low while an indicator falls to a more shallow low

exact_text:
They often wait until a downside breakout stops making new lows and then
trade against it: buy
added_conditions: wait until a downside breakout stops making new lows before trading against it
place a protective stop after trading against the failed breakout

exact_text:
A bullish divergence gives a strong buy signal; it occurs when prices fall to a new
low, but MACD-Histogram traces a shallower bottom.
added_conditions: bullish divergence: prices fall to a new low but MACD-Histogram traces a shallower bottom
bearish divergence: prices rise to a new high but MACD-Histogram traces a lower high
MACD-Histogram crossing its zero line signals the power of the dominant group has been broken

exact_text:
Stochastic becomes overbought when it rises to or above its upper reference line.
There it gives a signal to sell or at least avoid buying. Stochastic becomes oversold
when it falls to or below its lower reference line. There it gives a signal to buy or at
least avoid shorting.
added_conditions: overbought: Stochastic at or above its upper reference line
oversold: Stochastic at or below its lower reference line

exact_text:
Rising or steady volume confirms trends. When prices rise to a new high or fall to a
new low while volume shrinks, it tells us that the price trend is likely to reverse or
at least to pause.
added_conditions: rising or steady volume confirms the trend
prices make a new high or new low while volume shrinks: trend likely to reverse or pause

exact_text:
When the 2-day EMA of Force Index dips below zero during market rallies, it identifies buying opportunities, and when it rallies above zero during market drops, it
marks shorting opportunities.
added_conditions: 2-day EMA of Force Index dips below zero during market rallies: buying opportunities
2-day EMA of Force Index rallies above zero during market drops: shorting opportunities

added_parameters.name: Force Index smoothing for short-term trend
Force Index smoothing for bullish/bearish zones

exact_text: This bearish divergence indicates that it pays to go short.
added_conditions: bearish divergence: market rallies while NH-NL traces a lower peak, uptrend losing its leaders
bullish divergence: market falls to a new low while NH-NL traces a higher bottom

exact_text: this bearish divergence of NH-NL gave a sell signal
added_conditions: bearish divergence: S&P 500 reaches a new high while NH-NL does not
bullish divergence: S&P 500 falls to a lower low while NH-NL bottoms at a higher level

added_parameters.name: NH-NL bullish zone threshold (to reduce whipsaws)
NH-NL bearish zone threshold (to reduce whipsaws)

exact_text:
A bull market that has caught the attention of the general public is probably very old
and getting ready to reverse.
added_conditions: bull market has caught the attention of the general public
20 percent bullish consensus means big money is on the long side; be prepared for a sharp rally
markets often very volatile at tops; scaling into a put position may be safest

exact_text:
When the weekly trend is up and the daily trend is down, use those declines to catch
buying opportunities.
added_conditions: weekly trend up and daily trend down: use declines to catch buying opportunities
weekly trend down and daily trend up: use rallies for entering shorts
safer to wait for a pullback rather than entering when both weekly and daily trends move in the same direction

exact_text:
Prices moving outside of a well-drawn channel identify zones of
unsustainable optimism or pessimism, where the market is likely to reverse.
added_conditions: prices outside a well-drawn channel identify unsustainable optimism or pessimism where the market is likely to reverse
market undervalued below its lower channel line; overvalued above its upper channel line

added_parameters.name: channel containment target
added_parameters.value: 90 percent to 95 percent of price action
